content:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — hosted-api (us-east-1) p99 spike, autoscaler failing to provision GPUs. Paging @alex @maria @sam. Current: queue 12,400, error-rate up, p95 ~3.4s p99 ~12.2s. Affected: gen-large models only.

alex: ack. grabbing logs from autoscaler and infra. seeing repeated failures: 
```
ERROR: instance creation timed out (us-east-1a) -> InsufficientAcceleratorCapacity
WARN: provider api returned 429 CreateInstances rateLimit
```

maria: I'm going to open regional fallback to us-west-2 and switch heavy requests to quantized-medium model variant for 10min. That should cut per-request GPU time. Doing now. :white_check_mark:

sam: bump — kube-cluster-autoscaler shows backoff loops. snippet: 
```
E020 11:02:34.123 nodegroup.go:341] failed to create instance: quota exceeded or insufficient capacity
Retrying in 30s (backoff=2m)
```

alex: trying a manual provisioning for two reserved-gpu instances in us-east-1b via infra runbook. running: 
```
infractl instance create --region us-east-1 --zone us-east-1b --accelerator a100 --count 2 --type reserved
```

oncall-bot: pager acknowledged by alex (@alex). Declaring severity: S2.

lex: support note — customers seeing increased 5xxs. Top-5 enterprise tenants hit hard. I've emailed them and posted incident banner on status page. Current 5xx rate: 1.8% overall, ~12% for large-model customers in the region.

maria: routing change in place. Also enabling per-tenant soft limits and immediate cache reuse policy. Pushing config: 
```
route-policy set region-fallback enabled=true
model-variant route gen-large -> gen-medium-quantized
```

sam: manual create failed — cloud returned QuotaExceeded for GPUs in region. Contacting cloud support now, raising request with priority. cloud-scs: @cloud-scs can you confirm if there was a zonal capacity loss or quota hit?

cloud-scs: Confirmed — we've hit a temporary accelerator capacity shortage in us-east-1a/1b. Quota appears fine, but provider has limited A100 inventory, and API is returning 429s for create calls. We're requesting emergency capacity from provider; ETA unknown (TBD).

alex: fallback routing + quantized variant already reduced backlog considerably. Queue dropped from 12.4k -> ~2.1k in 14m. p99 down from 12.2s -> 3.2s. Preparing handoff to maria for continued mitigation and monitoring.

maria: taking over. I'll keep regional routing enabled and monitor error rates; if provider capacity doesn't return we'll start draining long-running requests and extend model-fallback to additional tenants. Handoff: summary attached in-thread. :passing_the_baton:

incident-bot: Handoff recorded — oncall: maria, previous:oncall alex. Incident channel updated.

alex: notes for post-incident: need runbook updates for provider-accelerator shortages (add immediate regional-fallback automation), add alerts for autoscaler create-429s, and plan warm pools in alternate zones. I'll own the postmortem.

maria: agree. also add customer-facing timeline and SLA impact calc. tagging this with labels: autoscaler, provider-capacity, routing-fallback.

lex: support will follow up with customer impact summary and credit calc.

sam: leaving a note — if cloud-scs doesn't restore capacity within next hour, we should kick off cross-region preemptible warm-starts to recover capacity quickly.

maria: Ack. monitoring dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/hosted-api/us-east-1 (p95/p99 panels). I'll post updates every 15m.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE recorded. Current state: mitigated (fallback routing active, manual attempts failed due to provider capacity). Next steps: cloud-scs escalation, runbook + automation work, postmortem scheduled.

alex: handing full writeup + logs to maria. assigned postmortem owner: alex. ETA for postmortem doc: 48h.

maria: thanks — taking it from here. will update once cloud confirms capacity or we start cross-region preemptible rollout.
